chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v01] Then, for the suitable adept, the secret rule is stated; then all worship is said to be kula procedure.

[tal-a29-v10] Here in worship, whatever substance is forbidden in scriptural tradition, the wise one should use it immersed in left nectar.

[tal-a29-v02] Thus, for guru and disciple established in flow, the supreme lord has spoken the essence in ordered worship.

[tal-a29-v03] What arises in one month for one appointed to the accomplished order would not arise in a thousand years through various floods of mantras.

[tal-a29-v04] Kula of the supreme lord is power, capacity, elevation, freedom, vigor, virility, mass, and consciousness-body.

[tal-a29-v05] For one seeing all classes of beings by such nature, with masses of doubt destroyed, worship is indeed of that kind.

[tal-a29-v06] For establishing such form, by the path of mind, speech, and body, whatever the hero practices is called kula worship.

[tal-a29-v07] Outside, in power, in yamala, in body, in breath path, and in mind: thus kula worship is sixfold, differentiating according to distinction.

[tal-a29-v08] Bathing, circle, pot, and the like, or sixfold placement and the like, are not used here; nothing done is for breaking.

[tal-a29-v09] Free from six circles, devoid of all coverings, consisting of knower and known: this is declared as kaula in the traishirasa doctrine.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v11] In Shri Brahmayamala it is said: wine is Shiva essence; without it there is no enjoyment or liberation; but with flour, honey, and jaggery it is that.

[tal-a29-v12] Female, neuter, and male forms give prior and later enjoyment; but grape-born is supreme radiance, Bhairava free from imagination.

[tal-a29-v13] This itself is the pure essence of light, bliss, and consciousness, beloved of the deities and eternal; therefore one should always drink it.

[tal-a29-v14] In the glorious Krama secret, by the supreme lord, argha-vessel, sacrifice-abode, and lamp are called three.

[tal-a29-v15] The secret in Kaula sacrifice: there argha comes from Shakti union, the abode is named earth-garment-body-seat, and excellence follows in order.

[tal-a29-v16] Lamp is ghee-born; cows are indeed remembered as earth-wandering deities; knowing this, the Kaulika should become diligent in those three.

[tal-a29-v17] Knowing the primacy of the argha-vessel, doubt may indeed arise about substances stated by Shambhu, and that doubt is defiling.

[tal-a29-v18] Having entered the fragrance-rich sacrifice house, facing east or north, one moves from reverse to proper order by supreme impurity.

[tal-a29-v19] One should perform purification, burning and nourishing, in order from fierce-gentle distinction, or from mother-presence mantra.

[tal-a29-v20] If desiring initiation, plan purification of the path; then, purifying things, by Shakti alone lead them to immortality.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v21] Supreme-enclosure or mother-enclosure mantras, or Mālinī alone, may be used in all rites.

[tal-a29-v22] One should fill the argha-vessel with joy-cause-fruit substances, and by the stated mantra identity bring Bhairava selfhood.

[tal-a29-v23] By that, the full self, going outside and inner wheel, should be satisfied by drinking drops within upper and lower.

[tal-a29-v24] Thus, from the rising full vowel stream union, desiring to see the self outside, one should worship outside.

[tal-a29-v25] An auspicious red cloth is set in a sky-like, vermilion-beautiful field.

[tal-a29-v26] A coconut-made vessel, filled with wine, appears in an assembled circular form.

[tal-a29-v27] The wise should perform sacrifice; the order is said from the northern direction through the northwest to Ganesh.

[tal-a29-v28] Worship Vaṭuka, three teachers, Siddhas, and Yoginis, beginning in the east below Ganesh.

[tal-a29-v29] The siddha wheel runs through four directions from below Ganesh, with Khagendra and Vijjāmbā.

[tal-a29-v30] The tortoise is paired with power and an auspicious girdle-mother.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v31] In the south, the victorious ram is paired with a joyful girdle and Kullāmbā.

[tal-a29-v32] Vindhya, conquered by old age, is paired with a girdle, Kuṅkuṇāmbā, and an authoritative six-pair.

[tal-a29-v33] In the northwest, Marutta to Īśāna forms the second row, with a sixth in order.

[tal-a29-v34] Six powers are named, including Sillā, Eruṇā, Kumārī, Bodhā, and outer-girdle figures.

[tal-a29-v35] These authoritative worshipful ones have many differences and an unbroken disciple lineage.

[tal-a29-v36] These six seals are named in order, from bliss-line lords to yogi-word figures.

[tal-a29-v37] The smaller leftward series runs from thumb to little finger and ends at the root.

[tal-a29-v38] The verse lists named billa groups in the rightward series.

[tal-a29-v39] The sixfold seats are arranged in order from the named places.

[tal-a29-v40] The sign-knower who wanders among seats soon obtains each attainable thing.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-jaitro yāmye hyavijitastathā sānandamekhalaḥ / kāmamaṅgalayā meṣaḥ kullā+ī+ambayā saha vindhyo@jito@pyajarayā saha mekhalayā pare / macchandaḥ kuṅkuṇāmbā ca ṣaḍyugmaṃ sādhikārakam saumye marutta īśāntaṃ dvitīyā paṅktirīdṛśī / amaravaradevacitrālivindhyaguḍikā iti kramātṣaḍamī sillā+ī eruṇayā tathā kumārī ca bodhā+ī / samahālacchī cāparamekhalayā śaktayaḥ ṣaḍimāḥ ete hi sādhikārāḥ pūjyā yeṣāmiyaṃ bahuvibhedā / santatiranavacchinnā citrā śiṣyapraśiṣyamayī ānandāvalibodhiprabhupādāntātha yogiśabdāntā / etā ovallyaḥ syurmudrāṣaṭkaṃ kramāttvetat dakṣāṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhikāntamatha sā kanīyasī vāmāt / dvidaśāntordhvagakuṇḍalibaindavahṛnnābhikandamiti chu mmāḥ śavarāḍabillapaṭṭillāḥ karabillāmbiśarabillāḥ / aḍabīḍombīdakṣiṇabillāḥ kumbhārikākṣarākhyāca devīkoṭṭakulādritripurīkāmākhyamaṭṭahāsaśca / dakṣiṇapīṭhaṃ caitatṣaṭkaṃ gharapallipīṭhagaṃ kramaśaḥ iti saṅketābhijño bhramate pīṭheṣu yadi sa siddhīpsuḥ / acirāllabhate tattatprāpyaṃ yadyoginīvadanāt

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v41] These named upward-semen figures are six authority-foot-abandoned ones.

[tal-a29-v42] They are called upward-semen because seminal flow is absent in the kula path.

[tal-a29-v43] The other guru wives play unafraid with unseized bodies.

[tal-a29-v44] There guru-ness is defined as kaula shines in such form.

[tal-a29-v45] They are not specially worshipped, only remembered, with air-fire-mother within.

[tal-a29-v46] Malini is worshipped in order, then the inner mantra wheel in kula.

[tal-a29-v47] In wheel-nature consciousness is mistress, the kula-lady and supreme goddess.

[tal-a29-v48] Then she is worshipped as supreme-inferior or single-heroine with kula-lady.

[tal-a29-v49] Bhairava, swollen with expanding power, should again worship the pair through the rest of union-bliss.

[tal-a29-v50] Like sparks from consciousness of great light form, one should here worship the deity group as a stream of rays.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-bhaṭṭendravalkalāhīndragajendrāḥ samahīdharāḥ / ūrdhvaretasa ete ṣaḍadhikārapadojjhitāḥ adhikāro hi vīryasya prasaraḥ kulavartmani / tadaprasarayogena te proktā ūrdhvaretasaḥ anyāśca gurutatpatnyaḥ śrīmatkālīkuloditāḥ / anāttadehāḥ krīḍanti taistairdehairaśaṅkitāḥ prabodhitatathecchākaistajje kaulaṃ prakāśate / tathārūpatayā tatra gurutvaṃ paribhāṣitam te viśeṣānna saṃpūjyāḥ smartavyā eva kevalam / tato@bhyantarato vāyuvahnyormātṛkayā saha mālinī kramaśaḥ pūjyā tato@ntarmantracakrakam / mantrasiddhaprāṇasaṃvitkaraṇātmani yā kule cakrātmake citiḥ prabhvī proktā seha kuleśvarī / sā madhye śrīparā devī mātṛsadbhāvarūpiṇī pūjyātha tatsamāropādaparātha parāparā / ekavīrā ca sā pūjyā yadivā sakuleśvarā prasarecchaktirucchūnā sollāso bhairavaḥ punaḥ / saṅghaṭṭānandaviśrāntyā yugmamitthaṃ prapūjayet mahāprakāśarūpāyāḥ saṃvido visphuliṅgavat / yo raśmyoghastamevātra pūjayeddevatāgaṇam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v51] The inner twelve is to be worshipped, then eight and eight, or four, as desired; what number indeed in the rays?

[tal-a29-v52] Maheśi, Vairiñci, Kaumāri, and Vaiṣṇavi are in the four directions; Aindrī, Yāmyā, Muṇḍā, and Yogeshi are in the corners.

[tal-a29-v53] The eightfold set from wind-end to aghora is then worshipped in order by the view of union-bliss, becoming paired.

[tal-a29-v54] In the eight-eight rite too, in the manifold-named rite, this rite is prescribed in many ways; its number may be a lamp garland.

[tal-a29-v55] In the Ratnamala treatise, letter numbers are lamps; the wise should count the letters of the chief worshipped vidya.

[tal-a29-v56] One may perform family worship together with pithas, fields, and so on, as spoken by the supreme lord in the Madhava family.

[tal-a29-v57] The fourfold set named creation, preservation, destruction, and order, together with pithas and cremation grounds, should be worshipped for enjoyment and liberation.

[tal-a29-v58] One should remember this rite for self or for Shakti's wheel, placing it in the body called pitha, supreme-lordly.

[tal-a29-v59] Attahasam is at the crown place, Caritra in the ear hole, Kaulagiri in the ears, and Jayantika in the nostril holes.

[tal-a29-v60] Ujjayini is at the brows, Prayaga in the mouth, Varanasi in the heart, Shripitha at the shoulder pair, and Viraja in the throat.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v61] In Edabhi's belly Hala; at navel and bulb Gosruti; at lap Marukosa and the city Paundravardhana.

[tal-a29-v62] Elapura at the east bank; from right thigh and hip, wall-haired Kuddyakesi and staircase; likewise in Mayapu-Ksiraka.

[tal-a29-v63] Knees calves, ankle-pair, your red king-palace; at foot-base Brahma-related Vairinci, time-fire-boundary girl.

[tal-a29-v64] I am not, nor is another — powers alone, but I; thus cultivate such impression always, from mere remembrance.

[tal-a29-v65] No lunar day, no asterism, no fasting is prescribed — devoted to worldly dharma, one succeeds always by remembrance indeed.

[tal-a29-v66] Elephant-black butcher bow leather-worker element-distinctions; fishermen potters and their beloveds, their wives — nine here, nine in sacrifice.

[tal-a29-v67] Confluence Varuna agitated-mountain tower-laughter Jayanti and the rest — golden city ninth, in the middle; and chief of them the wheel-bearer.

[tal-a29-v68] She presses the seed, here from rasa-and-shalka division — Kundalini, guide of the occupied seat, root-situated, wanders from all sides.

[tal-a29-v69] Having worshipped the wheel-rising thus — in the middle worship the Kula-mistress, drawing-together, at end's end causing destruction and nourishment.

[tal-a29-v70] One-heroine, wheel-joined, or going in cakra-yamala — among Isa Indra Agni Yama flesh-eater and the rest, from laughter.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-eḍābhīmudare hālāṃ nābhau kande tu gośrutim / upasthe marukośaṃ ca nagaraṃ pauṇḍravardhanam elāpuraṃ purastīraṃ sakthyūrvordakṣiṇāditaḥ / kuḍyākeśīṃ ca sopānaṃ māyāpūkṣīrake tathā jānujaṅghe gulphayugme tvāmrātanṛpasadmanī / pādādhāre tu vairiñcīṃ kālāgnyavadhidārikām nāhamasmi nacānyo@sti kevalāḥ śaktayastvaham / ityevaṃvāsanāṃ kuryātsarvadā smṛtimātrataḥ na tithirna ca nakṣatraṃ nopavāso vidhīyate / grāmyadharmarataḥ siddhyetsarvadā smaraṇena hi mātaṅgakṛṣṇasaunikakārmukacārmikavikoṣidhātuvibhedāḥ / mātsyikacākrikadayitāsteṣāṃ patnyo navātra navayāge saṅgamavaruṇākulagiryaṭṭahāsajayantīcaritrakāmrakakoṭṭam / haimapuraṃ navamaṃ syānmadhye tāsāṃ ca cakriṇī mukhyā bījaṃ sā pīḍayate rasaśalkavibhāgato@tra kuṇḍalinī / adhyuṣṭapīṭhanetrī kandasthā viśvato bhramati iṣṭvā cakrodayaṃ tvitthaṃ madhye pūjyā kuleśvarī / saṅkarṣiṇī tadantānte saṃhārāpyāyakāriṇī ekavīrā cakrayuktā cakrayāmalagāpi vā / īśendrāgniyamakravyātkavāyūdakṣu hāsataḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v71] Worship triad upon triad, joined with future own-triad — heart-coil, brow-center, this indeed, three in sequence.

[tal-a29-v72] Cremation grounds in sequence, field-born, with yogini host — eight-finger-high, upward-round, slender-waisted.

[tal-a29-v73] Red-circulating hearing-seeing lamps make with ghee — whatever else, in the middle worship own practice.

[tal-a29-v74] Non-duality indeed, not duality — command of the supreme Lord; declared by Siddhanta Vaishnava and the rest, mantras are impurity-joined then.

[tal-a29-v75] So long as light-endurance — lifeless they would be here in non-duality: vessel, eye-binding and the rest, circle, ladle small-ladle fire.

[tal-a29-v76] Abandoning here — success in good middle, in the vessel in the middle sacrifice the thin — this day-and-night sacrifice performing, and others by day.

[tal-a29-v77] With heroic feast done, subjugation — mantras succeed effortlessly; read here the seat-hymn in sacrifice, fortune-bringing invocation.

[tal-a29-v78] Forms or pair-forms, hero-formed — shaken-off, conductless — the wise should worship in order.

[tal-a29-v79] One indeed then the Kula-lord, himself having become so many — powers by couple-yoga satisfy like the universal form.

[tal-a29-v80] No sequence called would be in light-made consciousness — absence of consciousness indeed is not at all — therefore untimely, but satisfaction.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v81] Here in order, of the difference-tree root-uprooting — seat-wing discussion not separately fitting, for the supreme Lord indeed rests as in own-power abode.

[tal-a29-v82] Then japa to be performed from three-laksha-etc. distinction — as said in Sri-yoga-sancara, and that of variegated form.

[tal-a29-v83] At rising, at union, in peace — three-laksha japa is said; in mouth, in going-coming, in thread, in hamsa-named, in Shaiva pair.

[tal-a29-v84] These five lakshas declared — perform tenth-part homa; in eyes, in going-coming, in mouth, in hamsa, and in aksa-rosary.

[tal-a29-v85] In the union of Shiva and Shakti, six hundred thousand recitations are said to apply to the eyes, going and coming, ear, hamsa, and mouth, O fair one.

[tal-a29-v86] Recitation is remembered as sevenfold in the hand, pair, eyes, going and coming, ear and mouth, secret, and secret place.

[tal-a29-v87] This recitation, middle-placed in hundred-spoked and thousand-spoked centers, O fair one, is one hundred thousand of Rudra, and offering here is by one tenth.

[tal-a29-v88] In the eyes, going and coming, ears, mouth, between the brahma opening, breasts, hands, feet, and secret wheel, one should practice twice.

[tal-a29-v89] Wherever the eye goes, wherever the mind goes, there the hamsa is to be practiced twice, being of expansion and contraction nature.

[tal-a29-v90] That self is Matrika, the goddess, Shiva situated in the body; therefore one should not practice the distinction 'that other is I'.

chunks.sanskrit: [and]-antaḥsthaṃ kaṇṭhyoṣṭhyaṃ candrādvyāptistathonmanānteyam / evaṃ karmaṇi karmaṇi yatra kvāpi smaran vyāptim satatamalepo jīvanmuktaḥ parabhairavībhavati / tādṛṅmelakakalikākalitatanuḥ ko@pi yo bhavedgarbhe uktaḥ sa yoginībhūḥ svayameva jñānabhājanaṃ rudraḥ / śrīvīrāvaliśāstre bālo@pi ca garbhago hi śivarūpaḥ ādīyate yataḥ sāraṃ tasya mukhyasya caiṣa yat / mukhyaśca yāgastenāyamādiyāga iti smṛtaḥ tatra tatra ca śāstre@sya svarūpaṃ stutavān vibhuḥ / śrīvīrāvalihārdeśakhamatārṇavavartiṣu śrīsiddhotphullamaryādāhīnacaryākulādiṣu / yugmasyāsya prasādena vratayogavivarjitaḥ sarvadā smaraṇaṃ kṛtvā ādiyāgaikatatparaḥ / śaktidehe nije nyasyedvidyāṃ kūṭamanukramāt dhyātvā candranibhaṃ padmamātmānaṃ bhāskaradyutim / vidyāmantrātmakaṃ pīṭhadvayamatraiva melayet na paṭhyate rahasyatvātspaṣṭaiḥ śabdairmayā punaḥ / kutūhalī tūktaśāstrasaṃpāṭhādeva lakṣayet yadbhajante sadā sarve yadvān devaśca devatā / taccakraṃ paramaṃ devīyāgādau saṃnidhāpakam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v171] The body indeed is the supreme mark, containing all principles, Shiva, joined with the goddess wheel, the best abode of worship.

[tal-a29-v172] That same circle is principal, trident-lotus-wheel-space; there indeed the goddess wheel is always worshipped outside and inside.

[tal-a29-v173] After recalling one's own mantra, with those births and juices abundant in joy, by the rite of creation and destruction, one should touch.

[tal-a29-v174] The consciousness wheel aroused by the impetus of touch, its lord obtains the supreme abode, having satisfied all deities.

[tal-a29-v175] By the prescribed follow-up rite, with heart-stealing substances, likewise from one's own desire recollection within, one should fully satisfy.

[tal-a29-v176] Having made support-bearing, with mind-taken wonder-juice instantly sprinkled, with nature flowers abundant in own fragrance, from the sequence of the invaluable cup of one's own heart full of bliss nectar, I worship you together with the goddess in the body temple night and day.

[tal-a29-v177] From the boundary of Sri Vira-avali onward in the scripture collection, this supreme sacrifice is praised by the moon-crested one.

[tal-a29-v178] Or, seeing all the group of deities situated in breath function by the previously stated method, the teacher should worship them there indeed.

[tal-a29-v179] Satisfaction of the breath-supported goddesses is by brahma-nose and other distinctions, by hand holes entering the apana moon wheel.

[tal-a29-v180] Thus by breath sequence indeed one should satisfy the deity group; soon by its grace one then attains knowledge accomplishments.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-deha eva paraṃ liṅgaṃ sarvatattvātmakaṃ śivam / devatācakrasaṃjuṣṭaṃ pūjādhāma taduttamam tadeva maṇḍalaṃ mukhyaṃ tritriśūlābjacakrakham / tatraiva devatācakraṃ bahirantaḥ sadā yajet svasvamantraparāmarśapūrvaṃ tajjanmabhī rasaiḥ / ānandabahulaiḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāravidhinā spṛśet tatsparśarabhasodbuddhasaṃviccakraṃ tadīśvaraḥ / labhate paramaṃ dhāma tarpitāśeṣadaivataḥ anuyāgoktavidhinā dravyairhṛdayahāribhiḥ / tathaiva svasvakāmarśayogādantaḥ pratarpayet kṛtvādhāradharāṃ camatkṛtirasaprokṣākṣaṇakṣālitāmāttairmānasataḥ svabhāvakusumaiḥ svāmodasandohibhiḥ / ānandāmṛtanirbharasvahṛdayānarghārghapātrakramāt tvāṃ devyā saha dehadevasadane devārcaye@harniśam śrīvīrāvalyamaryādaprabhṛtau śāstrasañcaye / sa eṣa paramo yāgaḥ stutaḥ śītāṃśumaulinā athavā prāṇavṛttisthaṃ samastaṃ devatāgaṇam / paśyetpūrvoktayuktyaiva tatraivābhyarcayedguruḥ prāṇāśritānāṃ devīnāṃ brahmanāsādibhedibhiḥ / karandhrairviśatāpānacāndracakreṇa tarpaṇam evaṃ prāṇakrameṇaiva tarpayeddevatāgaṇam / acirāttatprasādena jñānasiddhīrathāśnute

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v181] The goddess-circle, situated in consciousness alone, is to be satisfied by the wise through universal enjoyment, from the mirror of consciousness.

[tal-a29-v182] Where all elements dissolve and burn, see that consciousness residing in the body, equal in splendor to the fire of time.

[tal-a29-v183] In this void-formed cremation ground, served by yoginis and siddhas, a play-place, greatly fierce, where all forms are set.

[tal-a29-v184] Filled with circles of sound-rays, with darkness continuously destroyed, free from all conceptual distinctions, alone in the state of bliss.

[tal-a29-v185] In the cremation ground filled with countless consciousness, terrifying consciousness, support of all deities, who entering does not become accomplished?

[tal-a29-v186] In the glorious Viravali scripture, Bhairavi spoke thus: having first performed sacrifice, for one fit for such propriety.

[tal-a29-v187] Having discerned the family, initiate one's own disciple in such a rite; by Rudra-power sprinkle him and place him near the deities.

[tal-a29-v188] Having observed his arms, kindle them by Rudra-power; with that same power offer flower to his hands anointed with scent.

[tal-a29-v189] Having placed his two unsupported arms, one should think of them as drawn by Rudra-power in the form of a blazing hook.

[tal-a29-v190] Then he himself takes cloth and becomes blindfolded; he himself drops the flower, and from that fall one discerns the family.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-saṃvinmātrasthitaṃ devīcakraṃ vā saṃvidarpaṇāt / viśvābhogaprayogeṇa tarpaṇīyaṃ vipaścitā yatra sarve layaṃ yānti dahyante tattvasañcayāḥ / tāṃ citiṃ paśya kāyasthāṃ kālānalasamaprabhām śūnyarūpe śmaśāne@smin yoginīsiddhasevite / krīḍāsthāne mahāraudre sarvāstamitavigrahe svaraśmimaṇḍalākīrṇe dhvaṃsitadhvāntasantatau / sarvairvikalpairnirmukte ānandapadakevale asaṃkhyacitisaṃpūrṇe śmaśāne citibhīṣaṇe / samastadevatādhāre praviṣṭaḥ ko na siddhyati śrīmadvīrāvalīśāstre itthaṃ provāca bhairavī / itthaṃ yāgaṃ vidhāyādau tādṛśaucityabhāginam lakṣaikīyaṃ svaśiṣyaṃ taṃ dīkṣayettādṛśi krame / rudraśaktyā tu taṃ prokṣya devābhyāśe niveśayet bhujau tasya samālokya rudraśaktyā pradīpayet / tayaivāsyārpayetpuṣpaṃ karayorgandhadigdhayoḥ nirālambau tu tau tasya sthāpayitvā vicintayet / rudraśaktyākṛṣyamāṇau dīptayāṅkuśarūpayā tataḥ sa svayamādāya vastraṃ baddhadṛśirbhavet / svayaṃ ca pātayetpuṣpaṃ tatpātāllakṣayetkulam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v191] Then, opening his mouth, make him bow at the feet; on his hands and head also worship the goddess-circle.

[tal-a29-v192] In the glorious Ratnamala it is said: by attractor-attracted and impeller-impelled relation, the navel is a bowl with a staff.

[tal-a29-v193] By left-ornament thighs, adorned too at hip — in the disciple-hand flower-bearing, employ the impulsion-weapon.

[tal-a29-v194] While that arrives with stobha, itself falls on the head — Shiva-hand itself, this very causes immediate conviction.

[tal-a29-v195] By this very procedure the guru should have him take caruka — and by the disciple tooth-stick; its falling as before indeed.

[tal-a29-v196] Hand-clap onward from eye-band-taking indeed — up to tooth-stick-taking there one should observe.

[tal-a29-v197] By intense mild and other differences, such power-descent — thus this samayin is declared in Sripurva, from Karakampa.

[tal-a29-v198] At appointed time, from hand-clap thus — in auspicious enjoyment-hand as it were — the guru should give left-nectar-flooded.

[tal-a29-v199] Without doubt, from taking, power-clan, maya-abandoned he may become — trembling in taking may be the initiate in recitations and the rest.

[tal-a29-v200] In another time, by destruction-purification, from maintenance of established convention — as vessel of accomplishment, glorious bliss-lord, it is said.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tato@sya mukhamuddhāṭya pādayoḥ praṇipātayet / hastayormūrdhni cāpyasya devīcakraṃ samarcayet ākarṣyākarṣakatvena preryaprerakabhāvataḥ / uktaṃ śrīratnamālāyāṃ nābhiṃ daṇḍena saṃpuṭam vāmabhūṣaṇajaṅghābhyāṃ nitambenāpyalaṅkṛtam / śiṣyahaste puṣpabhṛte codanāstraṃ tu yojayet yāvatsa stobhamāyātaḥ svayaṃ patati mūrdhani / śivahastaḥ svayaṃ so@yaṃ sadyaḥpratyayakārakaḥ anenaiva prayogeṇa carukaṃ grāhayedguruḥ / śiṣyeṇa dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca tatpātaḥ prāgvadeva tu karastobho netrapaṭagrahāt prabhṛti yaḥ kila / dantakāṣṭhasamādānaparyantastatra lakṣayet tīvramandādibhedena śaktipātaṃ tathāvidham / ityeṣa samayī proktaḥ śrīpūrve karakampataḥ samayī tu karastobhāditi śrībhogahastake / carveva vā gururdadyādvāmāmṛtapariplutam niḥśaṅkaṃ grahaṇācchaktigotro māyojjhito bhavet / sakampastvādadānaḥ syāt samayī vācanādiṣu kālāntare@dhvasaṃśuddhyā pālanātsamayasthiteḥ / siddhipātramiti śrīmadānandeśvara ucyate

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v201] But when making a son, then perform initiation — as said in Sriratnamala: nada-to-pha-ending, blazing splendor.

[tal-a29-v202] Having placed desire-end, it falls — by that here such order holds: of the sprinkled one, the child's placed-spoken purified-path method.

[tal-a29-v203] Of the straight-bodied, power arrived from feet to head, bonds-burning, blazing — the guru, identified with that, should meditate.

[tal-a29-v204] Having sat down, then from root-purification onward enough — up to end-purification's end, meditate the burning in order.

[tal-a29-v205] Thus all principles and so forth are purified, burned, and dissolved, then one meditates on Shiva, whether partless or with parts.

[tal-a29-v206] The yogi on the path nourishes what is of the same kind and burns the cluster of what is of a different kind.

[tal-a29-v207] By this purification, the child's inner and outer bodies are affected by the descent of power according to intensity and related distinctions.

[tal-a29-v208] Entering gradually, Rudra power produces this fruit: arising bliss, trembling, sleep, reeling, and other body-occurring signs.

[tal-a29-v209] Thus for the self whose bonds are stilled and who is joined in Shiva, one should make creation going to purified principles for remaining enjoyment.

[tal-a29-v210] Or for some there is not such possession; by the stated power it burns inside and outside, and thus he falls to the earth.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-yadā tu putrakaṃ kuryāttadā dīkṣāṃ samācaret / uktaṃ śrīratnamālāyāṃ nādiphāntāṃ jvalatprabhām nyasyecchikhāntaṃ patati tenātredṛk kramo bhavet / prokṣitasya śiśornyastaproktaśodhyādhvapaddhateḥ ṛjudehajuṣaḥ śaktiṃ pādānmūrdhāntamāgatām / pāśāndahantīṃ saṃdīptāṃ cintayettanmayo guruḥ upaviśya tatastasya mūlaśodhyāt prabhṛtyalam / antaśodhyāvasānāntāṃ dahantīṃ cintayetkramāt evaṃ sarvāṇi śodhyāni tattvādīni puroktavat / dagdhvā līnāṃ śive dhyāyenniṣkale sakale@thavā yoginā yojitā mārge sajātīyasya poṣaṇam / kurute nirdahatyantadbhinnajātikadambakam anayā śodhyamānasya śiśostīvrādibhedataḥ / śaktipātāccitivyomaprāṇanāntarbahistanūḥ āviśantī rudraśaktiḥ kramātsūte phalaṃ tvidam / ānandamudbhavaṃ kampaṃ nidrāṃ ghūrṇiṃ ca dehagām evaṃ stobhitapāśasya yojitasyātmanaḥ śive / śeṣabhogāya kurvīta sṛṣṭiṃ saṃśuddhatattvagām athavā kasyacinnaivamāveśastaddahedimam / bahirantaścoktaśaktyā pateditthaṃ sa bhūtale

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v211] If even thus it would not occur, recognize and abandon that one; then I will teach initiation with cognition to the pleased and wise.

[tal-a29-v212] Taught by Lord Shambhu and seen in the teaching of true being are nectar-fire-winds and weak and other fire-winds.

[tal-a29-v213] Fire, palace-peak fire, and wind, all with sixty, are said for each; this threefold mass causes stopping.

[tal-a29-v214] The remembered power seed should be placed all over the limbs, but that mantra adorned with twelve vowels is placed in the heart circle.

[tal-a29-v215] Consciousness resembling a hibiscus flower, with wind impelling from its middle and fire fully illuminating the wheel.

[tal-a29-v216] One should meditate on that and chant the mantra by name-separated union; from half a blink, stopping occurs for the disciple, without doubt.

[tal-a29-v217] O goddess, while appointed to each principle, one sees the self; but until the supreme principle is reached, this one does not see it.

[tal-a29-v218] By this gradual union he sees all paths, or instantly grasps all scriptures.

[tal-a29-v219] The accomplished yogi performs initiation for one fit, by method of principle practice, in separate principle rite.

[tal-a29-v220] Thus for this initiated seeker of liberation, in remaining conduct, the kul instruction endowed with five states is to be taught.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-yasya tvevamapi syānna tamatropalavattyajet / atha sapratyayāṃ dīkṣāṃ vakṣye tuṣṭena dhīmatā śaṃbhunāthenopadiṣṭāṃ dṛṣṭāṃ sadbhāvaśāsane / sudhāgnimaruto mandaparakālāgnivāyavaḥ vahnisaudhāsukūṭāgnivāyuḥ sarve saṣaṣṭhakāḥ / etatpiṇḍatrayaṃ stobhakāri pratyekamucyate śaktibījaṃ smṛtaṃ yacca nyasyetsārvāṅgikaṃ tu tat / hṛccakre nyasyate mantro dvādaśasvarabhūṣitaḥ japākusumasaṃkāśaṃ caitanyaṃ tasya madhyataḥ / vāyunā preritaṃ cakraṃ vahninā paridīpitam taddhyāyecca japenmantraṃ nāmāntaritayogataḥ / nimeṣārdhāttu śiṣyasya bhavetstobho na saṃśayaḥ ātmānaṃ prekṣate devi tattve tattve niyojitaḥ / yāvatprāptaḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ tadā tveṣa na paśyati anena kramayogena sarvādhvānaṃ sa paśyati / athavā sarvaśāstrāṇyapyudgrāhayati tatkṣaṇāt pṛthaktattvavidhau dīkṣāṃ yogyatāvaśavartinaḥ / tattvābhyāsavidhānena siddhayogī samācaret iti saṃdīkṣitasyāsya mumukṣoḥ śeṣavartane / kulakrameṣṭirādeśyā pañcāvasthāsamanvitā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v221] As consciousness may be unfailing in waking etc., so the kul rite is to be taught, situated in the yogini's mouth.

[tal-a29-v222] All to be done in waking; in dream, restraining per-mantra going; in sleep, the root-named expanded by own power.

[tal-a29-v223] In the fourth, only the messenger-named; beyond that, kul-lordship; thus worship proceeds for those full of own power.

[tal-a29-v224] The body-residence etc. and previously said five states ending in all-transcended, with stated distinction, he should explain to him.

[tal-a29-v225] For the practitioner desiring enjoyment, proper yoga consecration; having worshipped the god with resources, flawless made of gold etc.

[tal-a29-v226] Filling eight lamps with red wick and ghee, he should awaken; that worshipable in conch, and also the two kul lords.

[tal-a29-v227] In full bliss-nectar, by path spoken by Shiva's hand, consecrate him with that; afterwards he should do mantra accomplishment.

[tal-a29-v228] This teacher's consecration endowed with authority; but he should do with flour etc. and his sixty-four lamps.

[tal-a29-v229] By eight octads they are worshipped — in the middle as before, the two kula-lords; by Shiva-hand-stated method alone consecrate the guru too.

[tal-a29-v230] These two thus consecrated, known by the whole yogin host — of you there, the guru becomes liberation-giver.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-jāgradādiṣu saṃvittiryathā syādanapāyinī / kulayāgastathādeśyo yoginīmukhasaṃsthitaḥ sarvaṃ jāgrati kartavyaṃ svapne pratyekamantragam / nivārya supte mūlākhyaḥ svaśaktiparibṛṃhitaḥ turye tvekaiva dūtyākhyā tadatīte kuleśitā / svaśaktiparipūrṇānāmitthaṃ pūjā pravartate piṇḍasthādi ca pūrvoktaṃ sarvātītāvasānakam / avasthāpañcakaṃ proktabhedaṃ tasmai nirūpayet sādhakasya bubhukṣostu samyagyogābhiṣecanam / tatreṣṭvā vibhavairdevaṃ hemādimayamavraṇam dīpāṣṭakaṃ raktavartisarpiṣāpūrya bodhayet / kulāṣṭakena tatpūjyaṃ śaṅkhe cāpi kuleśvarau ānandāmṛtasaṃpūrṇe śivahastoktavartmanā / tenābhiṣiñcettaṃ paścāt sa kuryānmantrasādhanam ācāryasyābhiṣeko@yamadhikārānvitaḥ sa tu / kuryātpiṣṭādibhiścāsya catuṣṣaṣṭiṃ pradīpakān aṣṭāṣṭakena pūjyāste madhye prāgvat kuleśvarau / śivahastoktayuktyaiva gurumapyabhiṣecayet abhiṣiktāvimāvevaṃ sarvayogigaṇena tu / viditau bhavatastatra gururmokṣaprado bhavet

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v231] This foot's intent: he grants siddhis — the guru who was practitioner before; the other gives liberation enough.

[tal-a29-v232] Of the two tell knowledge threefold, all indeed sufficient — and own-ignorance bestow toward own-action-making.

[tal-a29-v233] The sixfold cause-named — which thus — who is supreme Shiva, together with Bhairava-lord: that octad described.

[tal-a29-v234] Individually seeing that all-selfhood, self-reaching activity — in eye and the rest the teacher transfers wherever, in whichever sense.

[tal-a29-v235] That indeed with full pitchers is supreme consecration declared — without externals too, so said in Sriviravali-Bhairava.

[tal-a29-v236] Immediately indeed for the enjoyment-seeker, most-perfected by yoga, the guru would do at once thus desired-fruit-giving piercing-initiation.

[tal-a29-v238] Of the disciple cakra-breaking conviction arises, certain — by which anima and the rest: accomplishment, in Srimala too it is taught.

[tal-a29-v239] On attaining upper-wheel state, that is indeed demon-possession — of mantra-sound-bindu-power-serpent-supreme-self.

[tal-a29-v240] Sixfold in the glorious Cave, piercing-initiation prescribed by the supreme Lord — fiery kula as own-scripture states, cakra beginning with eight stars.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tātparyamasya pādasya sa siddhīḥ saṃprayacchati / gururyaḥ sādhakaḥ prāksyādanyo mokṣaṃ dadātyalam anayoḥ kathayejjñānaṃ trividhaṃ sarvamapyalam / svakīyājñāṃ ca vitaret svakriyākaraṇaṃ prati ṣaṭkaṃ kāraṇasaṃjñaṃ yattathā yaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥ / sākaṃ bhairavanāthena tadaṣṭakamudāhṛtam pratyekaṃ tasya sārvātmyaṃ paśyaṃstāṃ vṛttimātmagām / cakṣurādau saṃkramayedyatra yatrendriye guruḥ sa eva pūrṇaiḥ kalaśairabhiṣekaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ / vinā bāhyairapītyuktaṃ śrīvīrāvalibhairave sadya eva tu bhogepsoryogātsiddhatamo guruḥ / kuryātsadyastathābhīṣṭaphaladaṃ vedhadīkṣaṇam vedhadīkṣā ca bahudhā tatra tatra nirūpitā / sā cābhyāsavatā kāryā yenordhvordhvapraveśataḥ śiṣyasya cakrasaṃbhedapratyayo jāyate dhruvaḥ / yenāṇimādikā siddhiḥ śrīmālāyāṃ ca coditā ūrdhvacakradaśālābhe piśācāveśa eva sā / mantranādabinduśaktibhujaṅgamaparātmikā ṣoḍhā śrīgahvare vedhadīkṣoktā parameśinā / jvālākulaṃ svaśāstroktaṃ cakramaṣṭārakādikam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v241] Having meditated, one transfers mantra piercing in nine forms into the body after heart-wheel piercing.

[tal-a29-v242] By placement yoga, the disciple is united with the supreme principle through a shining great flame after bond obstruction.

[tal-a29-v243] Thus the rule seen by me after initiation was spoken by Shambhu, with sound utterance according to creation order.

[tal-a29-v244] By sound one pierces the mind; sound-piercing is declared for mind located at bindu and situated in the brow-middle path.

[tal-a29-v245] O great goddess, in the heart target or bindu, the flame-radiant bindu awakens the object; this is proclaimed as bindu.

[tal-a29-v246] O beautiful one, shakta piercing uses powerful scent utterance while seated in triangle posture, curved and coil-shaped.

[tal-a29-v247] By non-utterance, having uttered, one pierces the whole world; thus bee piercing declares shakta piercing.

[tal-a29-v248] She indeed is supreme power expanding bliss; she goes beyond birth place adorned by five hoods.

[tal-a29-v249] Arts, principles, nanda and others, spaces, families, and brahma causes and letters are indeed she, the five-formed.

[tal-a29-v250] Thus she, the five kinds, emerging from brahma place and entering brahma place, shines absorbed in lightning.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-dhyātvā tenāsya hṛccakravedhanānmantravedhanam / ākāraṃ navadhā dehe nyasya saṃkramayettataḥ nyāsayogena śiṣyāya dīpyamānaṃ mahārciṣam / pāśastobhāttatastasya paratattve tu yojanam iti dīkṣottare dṛṣṭo vidhirme śaṃbhunoditaḥ / nādoccāreṇa nādākhyaḥ sṛṣṭikramaniyogataḥ nādena vedhayeccittaṃ nādavedha udīritaḥ / bindusthānagataṃ cittaṃ bhrūmadhyapathasaṃsthitam hṛllakṣye vā maheśāni binduṃ jvālākulaprabham / tena saṃbodhayetsādhyaṃ bindvākhyo@yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ śāktaṃ śaktimaduccārādgandhoccāreṇa sundari / śṛṅgāṭakāsanasthaṃ tu kuṭilaṃ kuṇḍalākṛtim anuccāreṇa coccārya vedhayennikhilaṃ jagat / evaṃ bhramaravedhena śāktavedha udāhṛtaḥ sā caiva paramā śaktirānandapravikāsinī / janmasthānātparaṃ yāti phaṇapañcakabhūṣitā kalāstattvāni nandādyā vyomāni ca kulāni ca / brahmādikāraṇānyakṣāṇyeva sā pañcakātmikā evaṃ pañcaprakārā sā brahmasthānavinirgatā / brahmasthāne viśantī tu taḍillīnā virājate

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v251] Having entered, she pierces body and self and splits apart; thus serpent piercing is told in Bhairava agama.

[tal-a29-v252] So long one meditates mind until mind is destroyed; when mind is exhausted, O goddess of gods, supreme bliss is declared.

[tal-a29-v253] Not senses, not indeed breaths, not inner-organ range — not mind, nor thinkable, not thinker, nor mind-act.

[tal-a29-v254] All states exhausted — the other-piercing declared: from mantra-power-world-form-knowledge-mass-station-channel supreme distinction.

[tal-a29-v255] Ninefold others reckon the Veda — teachers, secret-knowers — in maya-womb-fire-color-stream-joined three-cornered circle.

[tal-a29-v256] Having meditated, by terrible flame, by that split knots — with flowers strike and join; in the other, mantra-named rite.

[tal-a29-v257] By one of two nadis, consciousness in kanda-abode — concentrated, circulated — by five-eight flame, forcibly.

[tal-a29-v258] Led to sakti-spear-tip, somewhere in the circle employ — by sakti thus, the sakta practitioner; this piercing causes immediate conviction.

[tal-a29-v259] From support emerged, by moonlight-white flame, from impetuosity — by thumb-root-seat sequence of the disciple, absorbed, in sky.

[tal-a29-v260] Having purified the body — from ksa to end, remembering previously mentioned city-multitudes — from own-circle meditation reflects: world-piercing.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-praviṣṭā vedhayetkāyamātmānaṃ pratibhedayet / evaṃ bhujaṅgavedhastu kathito bhairavāgame tāvadbhāvayate cittaṃ yāvaccittaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam / kṣīṇe citte sureśāni parānanda udāhṛtaḥ nendriyāṇi na vai prāṇā nāntaḥkaraṇagocaraḥ / na mano nāpi mantavyaṃ na mantā na manikriyā sarvabhāvaparikṣīṇaḥ paravedha udāhṛtaḥ / manuśaktibhuvanarūpajñāpiṇḍasthānanāḍiparabhedāt navadhā kalayantyanye vedaṃ guravo rahasyavidaḥ / māyāgarbhāgnivarṇaughayukte tryaśriṇi maṇḍale dhyātvā jvālākarālena tena granthīn vibhedayet / puṣpairhanyādyojayecca pare mantrābhidho vidhiḥ nāḍyāviśyānyatarayā caitanyaṃ kandadhāmani / piṇḍīkṛtya paribhramya pañcāṣṭaśikhayā haṭhāt śaktiśūlāgragamitaṃ kvāpi cakre niyojayet / śaktyeti śākto vedho@yaṃ sadyaḥpratyayakārakaḥ ādhārānnirgatayā śikhayā jyotsnāvadātayā rabhasāt / aṅguṣṭhamūlapīṭhakrameṇa śiṣyasya līnayā vyomni dehaṃ svacchīkṛtya kṣādīnāntān smaranpuroktapuryoghān / nijamaṇḍalanirdhyānātpratibimbayate bhuvanavedhaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v261] Brow-middle-risen bindu-light-end, some beautiful form — by identity meditate the disciple, and afterwards make that-identified.

[tal-a29-v262] Thus form-piercing said; and here form approaches visibility — at end, union with that; the disciple comes, become that.

[tal-a29-v263] Eightfold knowledge — smell-and-rest named-faculty-ended — that, by own-nadi-thread order, cause to move in the disciple.

[tal-a29-v264] By pride-firmness-binding sequence, consciousness-named piercing — in heart-space immediately bears divine-knowledge-sun rising.

[tal-a29-v265] The body is supreme in subtle essence and gross in shadow form; it is known facing or turned away from mirror-like supports.

[tal-a29-v266] Thus one pacifies body divisions swiftly and gradually through channels, reaching supreme state by body piercing.

[tal-a29-v267] Whatever wheel is in the body, going to infant rest, gradually brightens that wheel; piercing gives named place and fruit.

[tal-a29-v268] Channels are three principal and others innumerable; unification by them is channel piercing here, making fruit.

[tal-a29-v269] In channel piercing, desired channel flow with principal endings like eye gives varied knowledge attainment.

[tal-a29-v270] The great yogi, by force, bursts the other channel enclosed by the strong tail-shaped channel and casts it down on earth.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-bhrūmadhyoditabaindavadhāmāntaḥ kāṃcidākṛtiṃ rucirām / tādātmyena dhyāyecchiṣyaṃ paścācca tanmayīkuryāt iti rūpavedha uktaḥ sā cehākṛtirupaiti dṛśyatvam / ante tatsāyujyaṃ śiṣyaścāyāti tanmayībhūtaḥ vijñānamaṣṭadhā yaddhrāṇādikabuddhisaṃjñakaraṇāntaḥ / tat svasvanāḍisūtrakrameṇa saṃcārayecchiṣye abhimānadārḍhyabandhakrameṇa vijñānasaṃjñako vedhaḥ / hṛdayavyomani sadyo divyajñānārkasamudayaṃ dhatte piṇḍaḥ paraḥ kalātmā sūkṣmaḥ puryaṣṭako bahiḥ sthūlaḥ / chāyātmā sa parāṅmukha ādarśādau ca saṃmukho jñeyaḥ iti yaḥ piṇḍavibhedastaṃ rabhasāduttarottare śamayet / tattadnalane kramaśaḥ paramapadaṃ piṇḍavedhena yadyaddehe cakraṃ tatra śiśoretya viśramaṃ kramaśaḥ / ujjvalayettaccakraṃ sthānākhyastatphalaprado vedhaḥ nāḍyaḥ pradhānabhūtāstisro@nyāstadgatāstvasaṃkhyeyāḥ / ekīkārastābhirnāḍīvedho@tra tatphalakṛt abhilaṣitanāḍivāho mukhyābhiścakṣurādiniṣṭhābhiḥ / adbodhaprāptiḥ syānnāḍīvedhe vicitrabahurūpā lāṅgūlākṛtibalavat svanāḍisaṃvoṣṭitāmaparanāḍīm / āsphoṭya siddhamapi bhuvi pātayati haṭhānmahāyogī

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v271] Touching nonduality in all wheels through supreme piercing, the teacher should make supreme Shiva, giving Shiva state.

[tal-a29-v272] Thus determined in the Shri Viravali lineage: the indivisible middle is to be known in every way; knowing it, one is not stained.

[tal-a29-v273] In that division order, the accomplished teacher liberates bound beings; the disciple enters before the teacher, and mouth pierces mouth.

[tal-a29-v274] Form in form unifies with objects; when mind becomes unified, the two attain a beyond-mind state.

[tal-a29-v275] By mind movement of both, at that time one becomes initiated; in moon-sun union the living being goes to that identity.

[tal-a29-v276] Here gods from Brahma, desiring liberation, restrain their own ray wheel for both enjoyment and liberation.

[tal-a29-v277] If that initiation is proclaimed as Shiva's, this motionless liberation is told for all beings.

[tal-a29-v278] From the striking union of fire and moon parts, pulsation removes external breath gone outward through darkness-form union.

[tal-a29-v279] Gone out through hair pores, wandering with all causes, taking the unmarked middle, it makes wander and releases.

[tal-a29-v280] By union and uprooting method, pierce the five knots; contemplate the union activity pair in the middle abode.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-paravedhaṃ samasteṣu cakreṣvadvaitamāmṛśan / paraṃ śivaṃ prakurvīta śivatāpattido guruḥ śrīmadvīrāvalikule tathā cetthaṃ nirūpitam / abhedyaṃ sarvathā jñeyaṃ madhyaṃ jñātvā na lipyate tadvibhāgakrame siddhaḥ sa gururmocayet paśūn / guroragre viśecchiṣyo vaktraṃ vaktre tu vedhayet rūpaṃ rūpe tu viṣayairyāvatsamarasībhavet / citte samarasībhūte dvayoraunmanasī sthitiḥ ubhayośconmanogatyā tatkāle dīkṣito bhavet / śaśibhāskarasaṃyoge jīvastanmayatāṃ vrajet atra brahmādayo devā muktaye mokṣakāṅkṣiṇaḥ / nirudhya raśmicakraṃ svaṃ bhogamokṣāvubhāvapi grasate yadi taddīkṣā śārvīyaṃ parikīrtitā / sa eṣa mokṣaḥ kathito niḥspandaḥ sarvajantuṣu agnīṣomakalāghātasaṅghātāt spandanaṃ haret / bāhyaṃ prāṇaṃ bāhyagataṃ timirākārayogataḥ niryātaṃ romakūpaistu bhramantaṃ sarvakāraṇaiḥ / madhyaṃ nirlakṣyamāsthāya bhramayedvisṛjettataḥ saṃghaṭṭotpāṭayogena vedhayedgranthipañcakam / saṃghaṭṭavṛttiyugalaṃ madhyadhāma vicintayet

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v281] One should not join self, space, outside, mantra, and body; this initiation gives Shiva state to all beings.

[tal-a29-v282] At initiation end, having cooked lamps, the offering should be eaten with all adepts by clan teachers destroying great sin.

[tal-a29-v283] Thus in Shri Ratnamala, the extra rite indeed pacifies that sin, and this pacification is proclaimed.

[tal-a29-v284] Next day the teacher's sacrifice should be done by him, because without it the rite does not reach completeness; do that with effort then.

[tal-a29-v285] By which the teacher is pleased, that should be offered to him; in the circle rite interval, movement is called the rite.

[tal-a29-v286] Having seen the well-filled bee vessel placed in the hero lord's hand, supreme Brahman, that should be drunk by the teacher's command.

[tal-a29-v287] Having satisfied beings, one should offer to the teacher; having made the teacher on earth, bowed and taken, satisfying sky-goers.

[tal-a29-v288] Having saluted own mantra, and that, female messenger, Ganapati, teachers, field protector, hero group, then by teacher order.

[tal-a29-v289] The substance touched by the hero should be drunk by oneself, never otherwise; those who know supreme Brahman are free from coming and going.

[tal-a29-v290] This should not be done together with those possessed of greed, delusion, pride, anger, attachment, and deceit, by one seeking welfare for oneself.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-nātmavyomabahirmantradehasaṃdhānamācaret / dīkṣeyaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ śivatāpattidāyikā dīkṣānte dīpakān paktvā samastaiḥ sādhakaiḥ saha / caruḥ prāśyaḥ kulācāryairmahāpātakanāśanaḥ iti śrīratnamālāyāmūnādhikavidhistu yaḥ / sa eva pātakaṃ tasya praśamo@yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ pare@hani guroḥ kāryo yāgastena vinā yataḥ / na vidhiḥ pūrṇatāṃ yāti kuryādyatnena taṃ tataḥ yena yena gurustuṣyettattadasmai nivedayet / cakracaryāntarāle@syā vidhiḥ saṃcāra ucyāte alipātraṃ susaṃpūrṇaṃ vīrendrakarasaṃsthitam / avalokya paraṃ brahma tatpivedājñayā guroḥ tarpayitvā tu bhūtāni gurave vinivedayet / kṛtvā bhuvi guruṃ natvādāya saṃtarpya khecarīḥ svaṃ mantraṃ tacca vanditvā dūtīṃ gaṇaptiṃ gurūn / kṣetrapaṃ vīrasaṅghātaṃ gurvādikramaśastataḥ vīraspṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃ dravyaṃ pivennaivānyathā kvacit / parabrahmaṇyavettāro@gamāgamavivarjitāḥ lobhamohamadakrodharāgamāyājuṣaśca ye / taiḥ sākaṃ na ca kartavyametacchreyorthinātmani

chunks.l2:
[tal-a29-v291] At the beginning, middle, and end of sacrifice, in guru worship, and in prescribed occasional rites, the disciple should perform this rite.

[tal-a29-v292] Thus the secret rite has been discussed and is very clear from the guru's mouth-experience.
